label: About
title: About The Depth of a Surface
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1266 recent saved-signal files and 832 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around Up and Down, In and Out, Step by Step, A Sculpture | The Art Institute of Chicago and Art Institute of Chicago II, Chicago | The Art Institute of Chicago, plus 4 more. A source image from artic.edu helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Depth of a Surface: A softly lit landscape museum gallery: two unequal gold frame fragments join around open ivory wall, carrying a rainy street into a nested picture. Two rear-view visitors gather at their shared edge above empty tiled floor. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Rust-red stepped path across pale stair treads and risers, Tall beaded gold frame around a rainy street and lamppost, and Right gold-framed umbrella and dark-dressed figure.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
